name: Banded Longhorn Beetle
desc: Banded Longhorn Beetle (Typocerus velutinus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Typocerus velutinus, known generally as the banded longhorn or cerambycid beetle, is a species of flower longhorn in the family of beetles known as Cerambycidae. It is found in North America.
